v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given there are no scheduled events on selected day when a 45-minute meeting is requested during normal hours then the first suggested meeting start time is 09:00
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given there is a scheduled event from 14:00 to 15:00 when a 30-minute meeting is requested then the suggested meeting must not conflict with that interval
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given scheduled event ends at 12:00 when a 30-minute meeting is requested then 12:00 is included as valid start time
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given meeting duration of 60 mins when potential clash time would cause the meeting to end v2_human 17:00 then the start time is not suggested as results
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given there are no existing events when a 15-minute meeting is requested then no suggested start time occurs between 12:00 and 13:00
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given the same set of scheduled events listed in different orders when meeting availability is calculated then the suggested meeting start times are identical in all cases

v1_human_g2_constraints.c_6: Events are valid stored well v1_human (assumption)

v1_human_g2_goal: To suggest all valid meeting start slots within default working hours that can accommodate a meeting of a given duration without overlapping any existing events.
v1_human_g2_input: events: type: List[Dict[str, str]], format: {"start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}, valid values: start < end, use 24-hour time format; meeting_duration: type: int; day: type: str
v1_human_g2_output: valid_slots: type: List[str], a list of meeting times in "HH:MM" 24-hour format
